study_identification_part.si_4_title: Detecting accelerated retinal decline in mental disorders through normative modeling

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: The study used optical coherence tomography (OCT) data from the UK Biobank database. Healthy controls (N=56,545) were used for normative model development, and separate patient populations with mental disorders (SZ N=171, BD N=265, MDD N=102) were compared against the normative model.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "This analysis used cross-sectional measurements of optical coherence tomography (OCT) from the UK Biobank database" ... "To estimate normative retinal decline, we used these measurements from N = 56,545 healthy individuals from the UK Biobank" ... "we then included N = 538 separate individuals from the UK Biobank with a mental disorder"
